summary.headline: ESAF SFB Q1 FY27 PAT rose to INR 80 crores from INR 24 crores QoQ; gross NPA fell to 5.4% from 7.5% YoY.
summary.overview: Total business reached INR 50,140 crores, up 23% YoY, with gross advances up 27% and deposits up 19%. Asset quality improved sharply: gross slippages fell to INR 75 crores from INR 468 crores a year earlier, and net NPA fell to 0.8% from 3.8%. Management also set aside an extra INR 65 crores over RBI norms and lifted PCR to 86% (81% without it). Management guided to ~2% credit cost and ~2% ROA by year-end FY27, and NIM above 7.5%.

segments.name: MARG (secured retail)
segments.commentary: INR 12,909 crores, up 42% YoY, 56% of total portfolio; agri, gold and mortgage cited as standout growers. Secured book up 35% YoY to INR 14,465 crores (62% of advances).

segments.name: Emerging Households (EH)
segments.commentary: Grew 185% YoY and 14% QoQ, now 32% of gross advances. Borrowers have annual income of INR 3-15 lakhs; ticket size under INR 10 lakhs; unsecured lending limited to individual loans.

segments.name: Microfinance (group loans)
segments.commentary: Portfolio declined; management says borrowers are being migrated to individual and secured EH products. Unsecured book up 16% YoY to INR 8,751 crores.

segments.name: Corporate loans
segments.commentary: Exposure reduced; management expects it to stay at current levels.

segments.name: Other income / PSLC
segments.commentary: Other income up 27% YoY. PSLC income was INR 69 crores in Q1; management expects INR 20-25 crores for the remainder of the year.

guidance_outlook: Credit cost expected to fall to around 2% by year-end FY27 (4.4% annualised in Q1).
ROA expected at about 2% by FY27 year-end; management said FY28 ROA would be higher than the FY27 revised estimate.
NIM expected to stay above 7.5% despite a possible moderation from 7.9%.
Book growth guidance of 22-25%; 25% minimum growth cited in capital plan.
ESAF 2.0 StratoNeXt IT programme expected to be fully implemented by end of calendar 2026.
Steady-state ROA of 2-2.5% considered comfortable over the medium term (per CFO).
capex_capacity: Distribution at 821 banking outlets, 721 ATMs, 1,064 customer service centres and 31 institutional BCs across 24 states and 2 UTs; 17 outlets added in Q1.
Plan for 50 new branches in FY27; 17 already opened and operational, rest to open in phases, mostly semi-urban and rural in newer geographies.
25% of branches must be in unbanked rural locations (regulatory requirement).
Customer base at 1.04 crore after adding 1.86 lakh customers in Q1.
Tier 1 capital raise possible by end-CY2026 if price levels are appropriate; promoter holding must fall to 26% by 2032.
demand_pricing: Disbursements in Q1 were about INR 8,500 crores plus, lower QoQ; management attributed this to lower gold-loan repledging after the recent gold price correction. Management said disbursement pace would be maintained YoY.
Gold loans are 40-45% of the portfolio per management; overall book LTV is 72%.
Retail deposits 91% of total; liquidity coverage ratio 133.31%.
Management cited subdued system-wide deposit growth as the reason NIM may moderate.
Non-resident deposits grew sequentially for four quarters.

qa_highlights.question: Will credit cost fall to 2% by FY27 end, and will the INR 65 crore management overlay still be needed?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said net NPA stock is only INR 184 crores and net slippages were INR 40 crores, so credit cost should decline next quarter. He guided ROA to about 2% by year-end.

qa_highlights.question: Will PSLC income continue?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said PSLC income will continue but at lower rates, with INR 20-25 crores expected for the rest of the year versus INR 69 crores in Q1.

qa_highlights.question: Effective tax rate and capital raise plans?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO expects an effective tax rate around 25.5%. Management said CRAR is close to 24%. A Tier 1 raise may come by end of this year if prices are right; price-to-book discussions have not started.

qa_highlights.question: Steady-state ROA in 3-4 years?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said 2-2.5% would be a comfortable steady-state ROA, given growth, IT spend and spreads. He said FY28 is too early to guide precisely.

qa_highlights.question: Why was the microfinance book not covered under CGFMU, and what recovery is expected?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said the micro banking book was not covered because its delinquencies were historically low; the bank will reconsider this going forward.

qa_highlights.question: Disbursements were lower QoQ; will AUM growth be 25-30% YoY?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said disbursement pace would be sustained YoY. CFO said book growth guidance is 22-25%, and the current disbursement level supports that range.

risks_watch: Credit cost depends on the 2% year-end target; a rise in slippages would undo the INR 65 crore overlay benefit.
NIM could drop from 7.9% if deposit growth stays subdued; the guided floor is 7.5%.
Concentration: 71% of deposits from Kerala (per investor question; not disputed by management).
Gold-loan disbursement intensity has fallen with gold price correction; watch disbursement run-rate.
Tier 1 equity raise and promoter stake reduction to 26% by 2032; pricing unknown.
ESAF 2.0 implementation by end CY2026 and related opex.
Management cautious on the West Asia crisis, though it said there was no material impact so far.
key_quotes: The improvements we are seeing today are therefore structural rather than cyclical.
While these events have not had any material impact on our business or operating performance, we remain cautious and watchful for future developments.
It is too early to precisely give a number because the liability side, how it is shaping out, what are the challenges going forward, what will be the RBI policy on the rate front.
We have not started those discussions.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on growth, asset quality and profitability, with management stating the improvement is structural. Cautious on the macro, citing the West Asia crisis and subdued system deposit growth, and reluctant to give precise FY28 ROA or Tier 1 pricing guidance.

adds.what: 50 new branches planned for FY27 (17 already opened and operational, rest in phases, mostly semi-urban and rural)

growth.why: Management guides book growth of 22-25% for FY27, backed by 50 planned branches (17 already open) and gross advances up 27% YoY, though no capex figure or utilisation was disclosed and disbursements dipped QoQ.
